basics.name: Prakhar Singh
basics.label: Founding Engineer @ DubaiDeals.live · ex-VP Engineering @ Deutsche Bank
basics.summary: Principal engineer and engineering leader with 12+ years across FinTech, EdTech, and e-commerce. Builds hands-on across edge-first platforms, LLM systems, and developer tooling, and has led engineering teams of up to 30 across three countries. Recent focus: agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, LLM orchestration and evaluation, and edge architectures.

work.name: DubaiDeals.live
work.summary: DubaiDeals.live is a consumer web platform aggregating every restaurant deal in Dubai on one live map: The Entertainer, Zomato, Careem, Talabat, Deliveroo, and UAE bank dining programmes.
highlights: Architected an edge-first serving stack on Cloudflare Workers that reads from a KV cache refreshed by an hourly scraper cron, with zero database calls at request time.
Built aggregation pipelines ingesting deals from The Entertainer, Zomato, Careem, Talabat, Deliveroo, and UAE bank dining programmes (ADCB, Emirates NBD, HSBC, DIB, RAKBANK).

Shipped 'Ask Savyt', a retrieval-first deal-search assistant on Workers AI (Llama 3.1 8B): the model parses user intent only, while deterministic code ranks and renders deals from the KV cache, one model call per query.
Delivered a live map interface answering 'what discounts can I get tonight, near me?'

work.name: Deutsche Bank (DWS)
work.summary: Working for The DWS Group GmbH & Co. KGaA (DWS), one of Deutsche Bank's associated, publicly traded asset managers. As Vice President of Engineering, I led a global cross-functional engineering organization delivering AI-driven trading automation and predictive analytics products.
highlights: Led a 30-person engineering organization across India, the UK, and Spain, coordinating product, QA, UX, and DevOps delivery.
Led delivery of an AI/ML trading-automation platform and predictive-analytics dashboards credited with ~€35M annual revenue uplift.
Built proprietary AI models and pipelines for anomaly detection, underwriting automation, fraud prediction, and incident response.
Integrated generative-AI copilots and RAG-based assistants into engineering workflows, improving developer productivity ~25%.
Built a career-progression framework for engineers that improved retention and internal mobility ~30%.
Established the DWS UI Platform, standardizing the design language and component library across the engineering org.
Introduced a Sentry and Datadog observability stack, cutting MTTR ~40%.

work.name: Noon Academy
work.summary: Noon Academy is an EdTech platform serving millions of students across 8 countries with multi-platform exam modules and adaptive learning. As Principal Engineer, I led mobile and web platform engineering, performance optimization, and personalization features.
highlights: Unified the mobile codebase on React Native, improving cross-platform consistency and developer efficiency.
Reduced app load time by 50% through lazy loading, bundle optimization, and performance tuning across React Native and Web.
Delivered multi-platform exam modules used by 2M+ concurrent students during peak seasons at 99.9% uptime across 8 countries.
Built native performance plugins and standardized the component library and UX patterns.
Shipped personalization features (adaptive learning paths, content recommendations) that lifted student engagement by 20%.
Mentored the UI engineering team and improved development velocity across squads.
Adopted automated QA and anomaly detection, shortening release cycles and reducing defect leakage.

work.name: Deutsche Bank (DWS)
work.summary: Working for The DWS Group GmbH & Co. KGaA (DWS), one of Deutsche Bank's associated, publicly traded asset managers. As Assistant Vice President, I led front-end engineering for key financial groups, building multi-channel UIs and contributing to the bank's Core Platform UI Libraries.
highlights: Led development of multi-channel User Interfaces for key financial groups (Funds Treasury, Regulatory Reporting), ensuring uniform UX across web, mobile, and desktop platforms.
Directed a team of 10+ engineers, defining technical roadmaps and implementing a formal coaching and mentoring program to accelerate team growth.
Managed project delivery across global stakeholders (Architects, PM, UX, QA) located in Pune, Frankfurt, London, and New York.
Architected and contributed to the bank's Core Platform UI Libraries, driving component reuse and long-term strategic goals.
Established team engineering practices: Agile delivery, TDD, peer review, and regular knowledge-sharing sessions.
Ran lateral and graduate hiring loops, including technical challenges and interviews.

work.name: Noon E-Commerce
work.summary: noon.com is an e-commerce platform with a large catalog targeting customers in UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt. As Senior Software Engineer, I owned the front-end of the entire logistics and supply chain across several web and mobile applications.
highlights: Drove front-end development for logistics and supply chain systems.
Delivered logistics and supply-chain UIs in close collaboration with design and backend teams.
Coached junior engineers, accelerating their onboarding.
Deployed mission-critical projects on AWS and GCP.

work.name: TalkValley LLC
work.summary: mentorstudents.org is a US-based product startup that connects prospective students with current/ex-students and hiring managers via recorded video interviews. As Senior JavaScript Engineer, I owned the front-end and backend of the recording, transcription, and listing pipeline.
highlights: Led development of a video interview platform using WebRTC.
Managed a remote team of 5 engineers and trained interns.

work.name: Simsaw Software Pvt. Ltd.
work.summary: Simsaw Software (formerly Pink Hand Technologies) is a service-based company with multiple US-based clients. As Web Developer, I built high-performance and scalable web and mobile applications.
highlights: Delivered full-stack solutions using Node.js, AngularJS, React.js, and other open-source JavaScript libraries.
Created technical documentation and implemented unit tests.
Collaborated in agile teams to deliver client solutions.

projects.name: System Architect · Devzy AI
projects.description: Devzy AI is a pre-seed AI DevTools company building an agentic AI system for automated code review and developer workflow integrations.
highlights: Built an MVP agentic AI system for automated code review, using multi-model orchestration (LLMs + tools) to evaluate code quality, security, and architecture in developer workflows.
Designed validation pipelines combining LLM reasoning with static analysis, test execution, and compliance-aware security checks (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2 aligned).
Implemented model routing and evaluation frameworks balancing accuracy, latency, and cost, with feedback loops to reduce false positives.
Shipped CLI, PR, and IDE integrations delivering near real-time review feedback across the SDLC.
